name: Beijing Saimo Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Saimo Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, and development of intelligent connected vehicle simulation testing products and solutions in China. The company offers Sim Pro, an ICV simulation testing, validation, and evaluation tool; Safety Pro, a functional safety and safety of the intended functionality analysis tool; and ICV simulation testing platform, a cloud-based ICV simulation testing solution, as well as customized ICV data platforms.
